build_download_hf_file: download a file from Hugging Face and cache it locally given repo_id and filename
create_tokenizer: create a tokenizer from a pretrained model name or path using AutoTokenizer with trust_remote_code
build_processor: create an AutoProcessor from a pretrained model name or path for multimodal models
test_parse_headers: test parsing a list of key=value header strings into a dictionary of custom HTTP headers
run_download_cache_url: run downloading a file from a URL with progress bar and caching to a local filename
